description: This file defines the SearchResultsController class within the SuiteCRM application, handling search result display, including pagination, header generation, and interaction with search results and module beans.

classes.name: SearchResultsController
classes.description: Controller class managing search results display, headers, pagination, and interaction with search query and results.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a search query and results.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the current search query object.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Returns the current search results object.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering of search results, including pagination, headers, and bean data.

methods.name: getListViewHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for list view based on module definitions.

methods.name: getListViewDefs
methods.description: Loads list view definitions for modules involved in search results.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Creates header info for a specific field in a module.

methods.name: getListViewHeaderLabel
methods.description: Retrieves label for a list view header field.
